targets.title: Bewertung gut, Behalten schlecht: Die Wirkung von Musik in Informationsfilmen [Good evaluation, bad memory: The effect of music in information films].
targets.evidence_quote: We replicated an earlier experiment by Brosius (1990) on the effects of background music on memory and evaluations of informational films.
targets.outcome_quote: In other words, based on our recognition test, Brosius’ (1990) claim that the background music condition is associated with poor recognition cannot be confirmed. Furthermore, the music and no-music conditions yielded the same recognition scores.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit failure to confirm the original recognition claim; the evaluation effects also fail. Authors characterize the main result as a null effect.
